_doc: Nemeses (systems/nemesis.js): named enemies born of a real deed, whose hatred escalates over decades, learn your habits, strike at your worst moments and pass the feud to their children. Days are game days (120 a year).

house.label: the head of a rival House

grudge: Men say you prosper. Enjoy it while you may.
{deed}. I keep it close, like a coin in a boot.
enmity: Every road you ride, I have friends upon it.
Your name sours in every hall I visit. I see to it.
You will learn what {deed} cost you.
vendetta: My father's blood calls for yours.
I know where you sleep, {you}. I know which road you take.
Pray your heirs are better guarded than your caravans.
obsession: I dream of your ruin every night. Soon I will not need to dream.
There is nothing I would not give to see {house} in the dust.

inheritedTaunts: My {parent} swore your House would pay for {deed}. I keep that oath.
You did not know my {parent}'s face. You will know mine.

letters.birth: To {you}. You will remember {deed}, though you may think it small. I do not think it small. I will have a reckoning, if it takes all my years. — {name}
letters.inherit: To {you}. My {parent} is dead, and their quarrel is mine now, whole. Do not think it died with them. — {name}
letters.succession: To the new head of {house}. Your predecessor owed me a debt of blood. It passes to you with the seat. — {name}
letters.moment: To {you}. I hear you are {why}. How sad. I will call on you soon. — {name}

momentWords.regency: a child ruled by a regent

acts.slander: {name}'s people spread foul tales of you in {place}. Your standing with {realm} falls by {n}.
acts.suitWon: {name} brought a suit against you before the court of {realm} and won. You pay {n}g.
acts.suitLost: {name} brought a suit against you before the court of {realm}, and was laughed out of the hall.
acts.scheme: Word reaches you that {name} has set a plot in motion against you.
acts.raidRoute: {name}'s hired swords knew your caravan's road from {from} to {to}. They fell on it, and your route stands idle.
acts.raidMissed: {name}'s men lay in wait on your road from {from} to {to}, but your guards saw them off.
acts.allies: {name} has bought the ear of {lord} of {realm}. That court thinks less of you now.
acts.alliesHouse: {name} pays {rival} to share the quarrel. {rival} turns colder toward you.
acts.assassinHit: An assassin in {name}'s pay struck at you{where}. You live, but bear a {wound}.
acts.assassinFoiled: An assassin in {name}'s pay was caught before the blade found you{where}.
acts.moment: They chose the hour well: you are {why}.

ends.revenge: {name} counts the debt paid and turns away from {house}.
ends.married: {child} weds into {line}, and the feud with {name} ends at the altar.
ends.extinct: The line of {name} has died out. The feud dies with it.
ends.faded: {name}'s hatred has burned out with the years.
ends.letGo: {name} inherited the quarrel, and chose to let it lie.

learnt.stance: They know you favour {what} in the field.
learnt.route: They know your caravans' road from {what}.
